boards.title: Your First Weekend at University at Albany, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A calm first-weekend loop across UAlbany’s Uptown Campus: orient yourself, find useful indoor spaces, add an activity, and end with a performance or event.

cards.title: Start at the Entry Plaza
cards.subtitle: Uptown Campus · 1400 Washington Avenue
cards.notes: Begin outside and use the plaza’s fountain, carillon, domes, and colonnades as visual anchors before heading onto the Academic Podium.
cards.short_summary: Get your bearings at the campus entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany identifies the Entry Plaza, main fountain, and 20-story carillon as features of its Uptown Campus.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus landmark; consult the campus map for routes and accessible paths.

cards.title: Circle the Main Fountain
cards.subtitle: Uptown Campus · Entry Plaza
cards.notes: Take a short outdoor lap around the fountain and notice how the surrounding podium architecture connects the central campus landmarks.
cards.evidence_claim: The university lists the main fountain among the refurbished landmarks of the Uptown Campus.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor location; conditions and access may vary with weather or campus operations.

cards.title: Find the Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Academic Podium · between Taconic and Physics
cards.notes: Use the Campus Center as your practical reset: check the building layout, locate dining and lounges, and note where Student Activities is based.
cards.short_summary: Locate campus services in one central building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Campus Center is on the Academic Podium between the Taconic and Physics buildings and includes dining, lounges, event venues, and Student Activities.
cards.source_title: About Campus Center | University at Albany
cards.access_notes: Published weekend building hours are Saturday 9 a.m.–11 p.m. and Sunday 10 a.m.–11 p.m.; holiday and session exceptions may apply.

cards.title: Ask at Campus Center Connections
cards.subtitle: Campus Center · first floor or West Expansion
cards.notes: Stop at an information desk for university-wide information or Lost & Found, then use the location as a reference point for the rest of campus.
cards.short_summary: A staffed information stop inside the Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Center Connections provides university-wide information and Lost & Found at two Campus Center information desks.
cards.source_title: Campus Center Connections | University at Albany
cards.access_notes: Published desk hours are 11 a.m.–11 p.m. Saturday and Sunday; hours may differ during holidays and academic breaks.

cards.title: Take a Game Den Break
cards.subtitle: Campus Center · first floor near the Transfer/Commuter Lounge
cards.notes: Build in a low-key indoor pause with pool, air hockey, ping pong, or gaming areas before choosing the next campus stop.
cards.short_summary: An indoor recreation break in the Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Great Dane Game Den has pool tables, air hockey, ping pong, and gaming areas.
cards.source_title: Campus Center Connections | University at Albany
cards.access_notes: Located on the Campus Center’s first floor; confirm current availability with Campus Center Connections.

cards.title: Map the University Library
cards.subtitle: Academic Podium · west end
cards.notes: Walk through the main entrance, then use the interactive floor maps to locate study areas, service points, printing, and collections for later.
cards.short_summary: Learn where core library services are.
cards.evidence_claim: University Library is on the west end of the Academic Podium and offers collections, reference services, computer stations, and study spaces.
cards.source_title: Visit Us: Locations, Directions and Maps | University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Use the library’s interactive floor maps and check its website for current building hours.

cards.title: Continue to the Science Library
cards.subtitle: Academic Podium · south end behind the Campus Center
cards.notes: Add the Science Library to your mental map and identify it as another Uptown Campus option when you need individual or group study space.
cards.short_summary: Find a second library setting on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Science Library is on the south end of the Academic Podium behind the Campus Center and offers individual and group study space.
cards.source_title: Visit Us: Locations, Directions and Maps | University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check the library website for current building access and hours.

cards.title: Move at the Dutch Quad Courts
cards.subtitle: Behind Dutch Quad · Uptown Campus
cards.notes: If conditions are suitable, take an active break at the outdoor basketball or tennis courts and fields listed behind Dutch Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany lists outdoor basketball courts, non-varsity tennis courts, a turf soccer field, and a grass practice field behind Dutch Quad.
cards.access_notes: The university states that anyone may access its outdoor courts and fields; use weather-appropriate judgment.

cards.title: Locate the Broadview Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Broadview Center lobby level · Uptown Campus
cards.notes: Make a quick note of the equipment-checkout location so you can return prepared for a recreation session with your UAlbany ID.
cards.short_summary: Know where recreation equipment is issued.
cards.evidence_claim: Recreation equipment may be borrowed from the Broadview Fitness Center on the lobby level of the Broadview Center.
cards.access_notes: Undergraduates, faculty, and staff need a valid UAlbany ID; graduate students need a Recreation & Wellness membership plus ID.

cards.title: Check the PAC Calendar
cards.subtitle: Uptown Campus · 1400 Washington Avenue
cards.notes: End by checking the Performing Arts Center’s current performance listings, then return for a program that fits your schedule and ticket needs.
cards.short_summary: Use the campus performance venue as an evening anchor.
cards.evidence_claim: The UAlbany Performing Arts Center has five performance theatres and publishes performance and ticket information.
cards.source_title: Performing Arts Center | University at Albany
cards.access_notes: Published weekend building access is Saturday 9 a.m.–9 p.m. and Sunday 9 a.m.–7 p.m.; performances and tickets vary by event.
